mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity present value, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months suggests labor market weakness, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising claims periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting investor sentiment and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling claims periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates expanding economic activity, which raises equity risk appetite and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 2% for 3 consecutive months signals contracting economic activity, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling production periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1% for 3 consecutive months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1% for 3 consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling sales periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
